policies.title: Hungarian ordinary passports: Botswana short-visit visa exemption
policies.summary: Hungary's current consular guidance permits Hungarian citizens to visit Botswana without a visa for up to 90 days.
conditions: Ordinary Hungarian-passport short visits are visa-free for up to 90 days.
Dual nationals must depart using the passport used for entry; work, residence, special documents and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Hungarian ordinary passports: Chad electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Chad now permits new ordinary visitor visa applications only electronically through its authenticated eVisa route.
conditions: Apply electronically at least one week and at most 90 days before travel, with the listed passport, photograph, booking, yellow-fever and invitation or accommodation evidence.
Pre-11 May 2026 non-electronic visas remain valid only to expiry; work, residence, special documents and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Chad eVisa service
steps: Submit the electronic visitor visa application with the required supporting documents before travel.
Apply no earlier than 90 days and no later than one week before planned entry.

policies.title: Hungarian ordinary passports: Côte d’Ivoire preapproved arrival visa
policies.summary: Hungarian visitors receive Côte d’Ivoire pre-enrolment approval online, but the visa is issued in person at the airport.
conditions: Submit electronic pre-enrolment and carry the approved document to the Airport Visa desk, where the visa is issued locally.
This normalizes actual issuance timing only; work, residence, special passports, carrier controls and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Côte d’Ivoire visa pre-enrolment
steps: Present it at the Airport Visa desk and receive the visa there.

policies.title: Hungarian ordinary passports: Sierra Leone visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Hungary's current consular guidance says Hungarian citizens can apply for Sierra Leone's visitor visa at the airport on arrival.
conditions: The airport application route costs USD 80 and is paid in U.S. dollar cash.
Online and mission routes remain alternatives; work, residence, special documents, carrier controls and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Hungarian ordinary passports: Sudan advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Hungarian visitors apply for Sudan's entry visa through Sudan's Embassy in Budapest before travel.
conditions: Apply through Sudan's Embassy in Budapest before travel; Sudan's Ministry of Foreign Affairs approves the visa and the stated process takes four to six weeks.
Operational travel restrictions, departure-permit practice, work, residence, special documents and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Hungarian ordinary passports: Niger advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Hungarian tourist visitors must submit Niger's visa application in person at Niger's Embassy in Berlin before travel.
conditions: Submit the tourist visa application in person at Niger's Embassy in Berlin; a valid yellow-fever vaccination certificate is a stated condition.
Work, residence, special documents, carrier controls and final admission remain separate.

conflicts.explanation: From 11 May 2026, Hungary's current guidance says new Chad visas may be applied for only electronically; prior non-electronic visas remain valid only to expiry.
Côte d’Ivoire's online step provides only pre-enrolment approval; Hungary's guidance says the visa is received locally at the Airport Visa desk.
